categories.main_business_segments: China Resources Mixc Lifestyle Services Limited operates primarily in two segments: residential property management services and commercial operational and property management services. Residential services include property management, value-added services to property developers, and community value-added services. Commercial services cover shopping malls and office buildings, including commercial operational services, property management, and commercial subleasing.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company emphasizes technological innovation and digital transformation, with investments in digital teams integrating production and research. It has developed proprietary digital platforms such as the E-MIXC app and the Zhaoxi system to enhance tenant and owner experiences. The company also applies technology-based production, operation digitization, data capitalization, and space intellectualization to improve operational efficiency and service quality.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The primary customers are property developers, property owners, tenants, property owners’ associations, and residents. A significant portion of services is related to properties developed by China Resources Group and China Resources Land. The company serves residential communities, shopping malls, and office buildings across various cities in China.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates extensively across Mainland China, covering 153 cities for residential and other property management services, 67 cities for shopping mall operations, and 47 cities for office building operations. It also maintains principal places of business in Shenzhen, Mainland China, and Hong Kong.
categories.supply_chain_position: China Resources Mixc Lifestyle Services Limited operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the property management and commercial operation supply chain. It provides property management and commercial operational services, including leasing and subleasing, but does not engage in property development itself.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic focus includes high-quality development, expansion through mergers and acquisitions, and deepening market penetration in core cities. It prioritizes technological empowerment, digital platform enhancement, integrated membership programs, and innovation in business models. The company aims to become the leading brand in commercial operation management and the most influential urban space operation service provider in China.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly from property management services, value-added services to property developers, community value-added services, commercial operational services, property management services for shopping malls and office buildings, and commercial subleasing. Fees are charged based on fixed rates, monthly rents, or percentages of rental income and operating profits, with revenue recognized over time or at points in time depending on service type.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company positions itself as a leading property management and commercial operational services provider in China, focusing on high-end and quality segments. It holds a leading market position in luxury shopping malls and is among the top-tier property management companies by scale. It competes by leveraging its integrated ecosystem, brand strength, and operational capabilities, aiming to be the No.1 brand in commercial operation management in China.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: As of 2022, the company reported revenue of RMB12.016 billion, a 35.4% increase year-on-year, and a net profit attributable to owners of RMB2.206 billion, up 27.9%. It manages approximately 299.2 million sq.m. of residential and commercial properties and 11 million sq.m. of shopping malls and office buildings. The company has shown steady growth through acquisitions and organic expansion, with total assets of RMB25.838 billion and equity of RMB14.326 billion.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes delivering high-quality, trustworthy urban quality-life services through an integrated platform covering multiple property types, customers, products, and services. It differentiates itself by focusing on high-end commercial properties, leveraging technological innovation, a strong membership ecosystem, and comprehensive service offerings to exceed customer expectations and enhance loyalty.
